features.name: Isometric room visual redesign
features.description: Improve bedroom and gym scene depth, placement clarity, gallery integration, and responsive desktop/mobile composition.
features.evidence: Added continuous isometric floor planes and grid depth, separated wall scenery from player-owned floor objects, reduced anchor prominence, redistributed bedroom anchors, framed the gallery, and widened the desktop studio layout. Visual-verdict passed at 92 after desktop bedroom, 390px mobile, and gym renders; TypeScript, 64 tests, and 21-route web export passed.

features.name: Pixel preview and navigation flow polish
features.description: Improve generated pixel fidelity, prevent room-theme loading flashes, and make primary forward/back actions and async feedback predictable.
features.evidence: Raised pixel preview detail from 48px to 96px and persistent fallback from 8x8/8 colors to 16x16/12 colors; added labeled original/generated comparison and publish-stage feedback. Friend and own rooms now wait for persisted state, room switching is optimistic with rollback, detail actions prevent double submits, and publishing replaces the form so Back returns to the originating feed. Visual-verdict passed at 91; 19 unit files/66 tests, TypeScript, database migrations/regressions, browser navigation tests, and web export passed.
